result.rationale: Energy Capital Partners is the existing ECP owner and must not be duplicated. The validated research also directly supports Continental Grain as a continuing investor, EHI as an April 2022 co-investor, and GSAM/West Street Infrastructure Partners III as the former sponsor through the April 2022 closing. Those ownership periods are missing from the current record, so the application outcome is a correction even though the original census-level ECP alias decision was no-change.
